class A: pass
class B: pass
class C(*(A,),*(B,)): pass
print(C.__bases__==(A,B),C.__mro__==(C,A,B,object))

class M(type): pass
class A(*(),metaclass=M): pass
print(type(A) is M)

class Proxy: __mro_entries__=None
class C(Proxy()): print("never")

class A(*()): pass
print("__orig_bases__" in A.__dict__)
class C(**{7:type}): print("never")
class C(**[]): print("never")
class C(*7): print("never")
class C(7): print("body")
